purpose: Run the supplied head/sampler exporter exactly once, then verify exit code, output line count, SHA-gate outcome, group completeness and lexical selection scope.

command.exit_code_source: local shell $? of the single python3 invocation (also printed as LOCAL_EXIT_CODE=0)

line_counts.head-sampler-exports.json.note: primary export line count (JSON, indent=2, trailing newline); this is the reported 行数
line_counts.note: line count rule: newline count, plus 1 only for non-empty files lacking a trailing newline; empty file = 0 lines
line_counts.head-sampler-analysis.stderr.note: 0-byte stderr from the in-container exporter: no warnings/errors

output_file.scope: same official capture, later window, all16rank; exact shapes or sampler-name families
limits: Shape compatibility and count ratios are not tensor identity or request/replay binding.
Group sums and kernel durations are not exposed critical-path communication or end-to-end savings.
Selection is lexical on exact exported dimensions/names, not all runtime consumers or all operators.

group_key_completeness.key: Type + Input Shapes + Output Shapes + Input Data Types + Output Data Types + Accelerator Core
group_key_completeness.note: Every group exports its full duration list as a histogram; no value sampling. Group counts are per exported CSV group, not re-counted from raw CSV locally (no local CSV copies).

selection_audit.criterion: lexical: exact exported vocab dimension token in shapes (129280/16160/16192) OR Type name matching reject|argmax|arg_max|sample (case-insensitive)
selection_audit.interpretation_limit: Shape compatibility, vocab-sized dimensions and sampler-like names are NOT function or tensor identity; no request/replay binding is claimed.

sha_verification.mechanism: analyze_head_sampler_exports.py asserts sha256(kernel_details.csv read in container) == SPECS sha256 before parsing each rank; exit 0 therefore means all 16 asserts passed
sha_verification.evidence_basis: successful in-container assertions plus output rows for all 16 ranks; the csv_sha256 field in the output is the expected spec value, not an independent post-run re-hash

transport.remote_effect: read-only: hashlib.sha256(read_bytes) + csv.DictReader over already-saved kernel_details.csv; no file created or modified inside the container

model.analyzed_target_model: DeepSeek V4.1 target text forward (per contract.json operator_or_subgraph; not derived from this CSV export)
model.note: 'model' convention follows zcode-import-layout-execution.json / zcode-live-execution.json: executing agent model, distinct from the analyzed target model.

residual_unknowns: No independent post-run remote re-hash was performed (one-shot/no-extra-remote-op constraint); SHA equality rests on the in-script asserts that gated parsing.
No local copy of the CSVs exists, so group counts/histograms were internally checked but not re-counted from raw CSV locally.
Shape compatibility and sampler-name matching are not tensor/function identity or request binding.
Group duration sums are not exposed critical-path time, communication time, or end-to-end savings.
Only window_ordinal==2 of the official capture is covered; other windows and non-lexically-matching consumers are out of scope.
